provenance.description: Status-effect facts merged from the rAthena server sources, the official 2019 client Lua tables, the reverse-engineered classic status table and the curated overlay. The client data file `korangar/archive/data/client/status_effects.ron` is generated from this document by `tools/gen_status_effects.py`.

robrowser.source: roBrowserLegacy src/DB/Status/StatusInfo.js + src/DB/Status/StatusConst.js (GPL-3.0 reverse-engineering of the official client's hard-coded classic status table); only facts are vendored
